title: pipeline-hygiene — forecast-call prep
subheader: Commit accuracy by team and region
caption: Read-only: agents inspect, people sell. Nothing on this page writes to the store or to source data.
Since last run (snapshot 2026-08-03): 9 new flags, 6 cleared, 4 closed, 3 added, 0 removed.
Close-date pushes observed in stored history; movement per se is not risk.
H11 fires on a single push >= 21d or >= 45d cumulative later-drift. Review marker at push_count >= 3.
Coverage basis: trailing win rate 17/22 closed won (77.3%) -> required multiple 22/17 = 1.29x
Committed-for quarter = fiscal quarter of the close date when the deal was first called commit — immune to later pushes, so a slipped commit stays counted against the quarter it was promised for.

Of opps ever forecast commit in stored history: outcome to date. Pushed = still open with a close-date move after the first commit snapshot. Won/resolved counts closed opps only, shown as won/closed; the percentage appears once 5+ have resolved (small-n rates mislead). Of which pushed first = resolved commits that pushed after the commit and before closing. Coaching signal, not a comp input.

Reconciles exactly: beginning + created + increased − decreased − won − lost − removed = ending. Close-date pushes moved no dollars: 6 open opp(s) ($390,700) pushed later — an annotation, never a bucket.
Mean $322,732/week over 3 snapshot pair(s). No pipeline_gen_weekly_target configured — no target line is guessed.
Select an owner row to drill into their open flagged opps.

small_n = fewer than 5 open opps, treat the score as anecdotal. Coverage = open pipeline vs required pipeline (remaining quota net of wins this quarter x the required multiple); low_coverage means under 1.00x; gap to cover = required minus open pipeline on the same basis. Basis: trailing win rate 17/22 closed won (77.3%) -> required multiple 22/17 = 1.29x.
Note: 59 of 60 quota'd owners are under 1.00x — desk-wide under-coverage, not individual laggards; ordering carries the signal. The flag and its basis are unchanged.
Coaching signal, not a comp input.
No overcall/undercall patterns flagged.
Suppressed as small_n: 60 owners with too little history to score.

Coverage = open pipeline vs required pipeline (remaining quota net of wins this quarter x the required multiple); low_coverage means under 1.00x. Worst coverage first. Basis: trailing win rate 17/22 closed won (77.3%) -> required multiple 22/17 = 1.29x.
Note: 9 of 9 teams are under 1.00x — desk-wide under-coverage, not individual laggards; ordering carries the signal. The flag and its basis are unchanged.

Coverage per stored snapshot, each on its own win-rate basis; 1.00x is the bar. A team improving reads as a rising line — the trend the single-snapshot tables above cannot show.

95 open opps with violations match the filters. Rule legend: H1 stale by stage; H2 close date in past; H3 serial slippage; H4 missing/expired next step; H5 forecast mismatch; H6 aging in stage; H7 single-threaded big deal; H8 amount hygiene; H9 vague next step; H10 parked close date; H11 lost deal control
Quotas and team/region merged from `<QUOTAS>`.

Filters apply to the Risky commits, Slippage, Owners and Appendix tables; headline metrics, the Flow tab and team/region rollups stay desk-wide. Severity filter: an opp appears under **each** severity it carries, so one opp can match several selections; empty filters mean no restriction.
